name: Flexing for Nougat
summary: At the Gilded Rose, Innkeeper Allison asks you to flex before she gives you Stormwind Nougat. During Hallow's End, you gather festive sweets for Jesper, an orphan in Stormwind.

sections.title: A Hallow's End Tradition
sections.body: Hallow's End brings a lighter mood to Stormwind. The holiday marks the turn of the seasons and guards against dark spirits. Common folk celebrate with disguises, revelry and trick-or-treating. Alliance innkeepers offer traditional sweets to those who perform a harmless trick.

sections.title: Entertaining the Innkeeper
sections.body: At the Gilded Rose in the Trade District, Innkeeper Allison asks for a show before handing out holiday candy. You are gathering sweets for Jesper, an orphaned boy. Allison playfully comments on your physique and asks you to flex your muscles. When you do, she gives you a piece of chewy Stormwind Nougat.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Allison make people flex?
faq.answer: Hallow's End trades tricks for treats, so Innkeeper Allison asks you to show your muscles before giving you a sweet.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You meet Innkeeper Allison at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District, where she tends the tavern counter.

faq.q: Who is the Stormwind Nougat meant for?
faq.answer: The nougat is for Jesper, an orphan boy staying in Stormwind. He hopes to taste traditional festival treats from each major Alliance city during Hallow's End.
Stormwind Nougat is a regional sweet that Stormwind's innkeepers hand out during Hallow's End. Festival-goers know it as one of the human kingdom's signature treats.

faq.q: Can Horde players obtain this treat from Allison?
faq.answer: No. Innkeeper Allison lives in Alliance-controlled Stormwind City and serves Alliance members. Horde adventurers perform festive tricks for innkeepers in their own capital cities.

aliases: when is flexing for nougat available
faq.answer: No. Innkeeper Allison makes this request only during Hallow's End, when trick-or-treating customs fill the cities.

angles.text: For the Alliance, this playful exchange reflects Stormwind's lighter community spirit during Hallow's End and other seasonal festivals. It brings citizens and wandering heroes together for a laugh.
As a human in Stormwind, you know indulging children and trading tricks for treats is a cherished seasonal custom. It offers brief relief from the darker perils facing the kingdom.
As a warrior, you know bloody battlefields well. Flexing for an innkeeper is a harmless, if slightly undignified, show of strength.
